cues.en: Instructor: In this video, I am going to tell you about cumulative distribution functions, which are often abbreviated as cdf or cdfs.
cues.zh: 講師：這部影片要介紹累積分布函數，通常簡寫為 CDF，複數為 CDFs。

cues.en: And let's actually start with a little bit of visual intuition, and then we'll switch to a more formal definition.
cues.zh: 先從一點視覺直覺開始，再切換到較正式的定義。

cues.en: And then at the end of this video, we'll go through a few examples to make sure you get the concept.
cues.zh: 影片最後會看幾個例子，確保你理解這個概念。

cues.en: And then of course, in the next video, you will see cdfs and pdfs implemented in code.
cues.zh: 當然，下一部影片會看到用程式實作 CDF 和 PDF。

cues.en: All right, so here we have a probability density function, and here is its corresponding cumulative distribution function.
cues.zh: 這裡有一個機率密度函數，這裡是對應的累積分布函數。

cues.en: Now, I would like you to take a moment, maybe pause the video if you like, and just kind of meditate on these two functions and see if you can get an idea,
cues.zh: 請花一點時間，如果願意可以暫停影片，仔細觀察這兩個函數，看看能否產生一個想法，

cues.en: see if you can generate a hypothesis about the relationship between the cdf and the pdf.
cues.zh: 對 CDF 和 PDF 之間的關係提出假設。

cues.en: So how do you get a cdf from a pdf, and what is the relationship between these two?
cues.zh: 如何由 PDF 得到 CDF？兩者是什麼關係？

cues.en: Okay, did you pause the video and have a thought about this?
cues.zh: 好，有暫停影片思考嗎？

cues.en: So before I explain what a cdf is and how you generate a cdf, let me show you another example and you can test whether your hypothesis that you made
cues.zh: 在解釋 CDF 是什麼、如何產生之前，再看一個例子，測試你根據

cues.en: based on these data also generalizes to this new situation.
cues.zh: 這些資料提出的假設，是否也能推廣到新情況。

cues.en: So here, we have a different probability density function over here, and here in the green line is its corresponding cdf.
cues.zh: 這裡是另一個機率密度函數，綠線則是它對應的 CDF。

cues.en: So you can see whether your hypothesis about how to create a cdf and how to interpret a cdf also applies to or generalizes to this new piece of data.
cues.zh: 看看你對如何建立和解讀 CDF 的假設，是否也適用、能推廣到這組新資料。

cues.en: Okay, so I hope you built up the right intuition.
cues.zh: 希望你已建立正確直覺。

cues.en: Let me now explain what a cdf means and where it comes from.
cues.zh: 現在解釋 CDF 的意義和來源。

cues.en: So essentially, it comes right from the name, it's a cumulative distribution function or cumulative probability density.
cues.zh: 基本上，名稱就直接說明了，它是累積分布函數，或累積機率密度。

cues.en: So the way to create a cdf is you start from the pdf and you sum up all of the values to the left.
cues.zh: 建立 CDF 的方式，就是從 PDF 開始，把左側所有值加總。

cues.en: And that is the value of the cdf at that point.
cues.zh: 結果就是該點的 CDF 值。

cues.en: So for example, the cdf, so let's think about this blue line here, this blue probability function.
cues.zh: 例如，想想這條藍線，這個藍色機率函數的 CDF。

cues.en: The value at .5 over here, so when x is .5, the y-axis value, let's say maybe that's .2,
cues.zh: 這裡 0.5 的值，也就是 x=0.5 時的 Y 軸值，假設大約是 0.2，

cues.en: that corresponds to the sum of all of these values up to .5.
cues.zh: 它對應到所有直到 0.5 的這些數值之和。

cues.en: So all the values to the left of .5, you take all of these values and you sum them up, and that is going to give you, that sum is going to give you .2 or whatever this value happens to be here.
cues.zh: 也就是把 0.5 左側的所有值加總，總和就會是 0.2，或這裡實際的值。

cues.en: So the cdf is basically just the cumulative sum or the integral when you're working with continuous functions to the left of each of these x-axis points.
cues.zh: 所以 CDF 基本上就是每個 X 軸位置左側的累積總和；處理連續函數時，則是積分。

cues.en: So pretty straightforward, I think.
cues.zh: 我想相當直接。

cues.en: Here, you see, for example, let's look at this green function here.
cues.zh: 例如，看看這個綠色函數。

cues.en: So we see that there isn't much change here.
cues.zh: 這裡幾乎沒有變化。

cues.en: The probability is very, very close to 0 all the way throughout here, and that's why...
cues.zh: 這一整段的機率都非常非常接近 0，所以……

cues.en: Yeah, you sum up values that are really close to 0, you're just gonna get 0, basically.
cues.zh: 把非常接近 0 的值加總，基本上還是得到 0。

cues.en: And then there's this explosive growth.
cues.zh: 接著出現爆發性的成長。

cues.en: So the pdf is increasing rapidly, the probabilities are increasing rapidly, so the cdf also increases rapidly.
cues.zh: PDF 快速增加，機率快速增加，因此 CDF 也快速增加。

cues.en: Now, here, what's happening is that the probability distribution is going down, so the probabilities are decreasing, but of course, because we are summing,
cues.zh: 這裡則是機率分布開始下降，機率降低；但因為我們做的是加總，

cues.en: the cdf is always going to be increasing, the question is: How quickly does the cdf increase?
cues.zh: CDF 仍然會增加，問題是增加得多快。

cues.en: Now, as the probabilities decrease, the cdf is going to increase more slowly and you can see that it's asymptoting to 1 here.
cues.zh: 隨著機率下降，CDF 的增加速度會變慢，可以看到這裡漸近於 1。

cues.en: So these values are probably not exactly 1 yet because these values are not exactly 0 here, but these probability values are very, very small.
cues.zh: 這些值可能還不完全是 1，因為這裡的值也不完全為 0，但機率值非常非常小。

cues.en: So the cdf values are very, very close to 1.
cues.zh: 所以 CDF 值非常非常接近 1。

cues.en: Essentially this means that by the time you get out to 1.1, let's say value of 1.1, you've basically had...
cues.zh: 基本上，當走到例如 1.1 這個值時，就已經……

cues.en: All of the probabilities, pretty much all the probabilities, are exhausted from this green function by this data point over here.
cues.zh: 到了這個資料點，綠色函數的機率幾乎全部都已累積完了。

cues.en: Okay, so cdfs always get to 1.
cues.zh: 所以 CDF 最後總會到 1。

cues.en: Now, that may seem strange, it may seem inconsistent because when you look at this blue line, you see it's actually not getting up to 1.
cues.zh: 這可能看起來奇怪、不一致，因為看這條藍線，它其實沒有到 1。

cues.en: it's increasing, but it's clearly not at a value of 1, which would be the top of this graph here.
cues.zh: 它在增加，但顯然還沒到圖形頂端代表的 1。

cues.en: Well, what's actually happening here is that this blue probability distribution is actually still non-0.
cues.zh: 實際上，是因為藍色機率分布仍然不是 0。

cues.en: It's still not getting down to 0, even all the way out at 5.
cues.zh: 即使到 5，仍然沒有降到 0。

cues.en: So eventually, if you would run this x-axis out longer, maybe have to get to 10, or 15, or 20, then you would eventually see
cues.zh: 所以，如果把 X 軸再延伸，也許到 10、15 或 20，最後就會看到

cues.en: that this asymptotically approaches 1, and eventually out at infinity, this really does reach 1.
cues.zh: 它漸近於 1，到了無窮遠，才真正達到 1。

cues.en: Now, another thing I would like to point out about cdfs versus pdfs is that the probabilities, as you know, this is part of the definition of a probability function
cues.zh: 另外想指出 CDF 和 PDF 的差異：你已經知道，機率函數定義的一部分，

cues.en: that all the values sum to 1.
cues.zh: 是所有值的總和為 1。

cues.en: So if you would sum up all of these values, you would get 1.
cues.zh: 如果把所有這些值加總，就會得到 1。

cues.en: Obviously, that's not going to be the case for cdfs.
cues.zh: CDF 顯然不是這樣。

cues.en: If you sum all of the values of a cdf, you're not going to get 1.
cues.zh: 把 CDF 的所有值加總，不會得到 1。

cues.en: You're gonna get some number that's larger than 1.
cues.zh: 會得到大於 1 的數字。

cues.en: You can even already see that here.
cues.zh: 這裡其實已經看得出來。

cues.en: I mean, it's pretty obvious.
cues.zh: 很明顯。

cues.en: All these values are basically at 1.
cues.zh: 這些值基本上都在 1 附近。

cues.en: They're very close to 1.
cues.zh: 非常接近 1。

cues.en: So summing up all of these is going to give you a larger value to 1.
cues.zh: 所以全部相加，會得到大於 1 的值。

cues.en: So the cdfs always approach 1, they get to 1 as you go to larger x-axis values to the right, but they do not sum to 1 the same way that a probability function sums to 1.
cues.zh: 因此，CDF 總是趨近於 1，往右到更大的 X 值時會到達 1，但不像機率函數那樣總和為 1。

cues.en: Okay, very good.
cues.zh: 好，很好。

cues.en: That was even slightly more explanation than I intended to give on this slide.
cues.zh: 這張投影片的解釋，比原本打算的還多了一點。

cues.en: So let's go a little bit more formal.
cues.zh: 來稍微正式一點。

cues.en: So a cdf is the cumulative sum or the integral of the probability distribution or the probability mass or the probability density.
cues.zh: CDF 是機率分布、機率質量或機率密度的累積總和或積分。

cues.en: Whether it's appropriate to use sum, or integral, or distribution, or density, depends on whether you are working with discrete probabilities or continuous probabilities.
cues.zh: 該使用加總、積分、分布或密度，取決於處理的是離散還是連續機率。

cues.en: Essentially whether you're doing...
cues.zh: 基本上，要看你是在……

cues.en: you can think of this as whether you're doing probabilities on computers where everything is discretized or using integrals in like chalkboard math.
cues.zh: 可以想成，是在電腦上處理一切都離散化的機率，還是在黑板數學中使用積分。

cues.en: And so the y-axis value at each x-axis value of the cdf is the sum of all the probabilities to the left of that x-axis value,
cues.zh: 因此，CDF 每個 X 軸值對應的 Y 軸值，是該 X 值左側所有機率的總和，

cues.en: exactly as I explained on the previous slide.
cues.zh: 就像上一張投影片說明的一樣。

cues.en: So cdf starts at 0 and increases monotonically to 1.
cues.zh: 所以 CDF 從 0 開始，單調增加到 1。

cues.en: So a cdf can never...
cues.zh: CDF 絕不會……

cues.en: it can't turn around and start going down.
cues.zh: 不會轉向開始下降。

cues.en: It's always going to go up.
cues.zh: 永遠只會往上。

cues.en: The question is: How quickly does it go up and when does it go up?
cues.zh: 問題是，增加得多快，以及何時增加？

cues.en: That is defined by the probability distribution, but the cdf always starts at 0.
cues.zh: 這由機率分布決定，但 CDF 總是從 0 開始。

cues.en: It monotonically increases to 1.
cues.zh: 單調增加到 1。

cues.en: Here, we have a couple of formulas that corresponds to basically things that I've already explained.
cues.zh: 這裡有幾個公式，對應的基本上是已經解釋過的內容。

cues.en: So the cumulative distribution function of x at point a, so this would be x-axis location of a, is the probability of the x-axis values, our data value,
cues.zh: x 在 a 點的累積分布函數，也就是 X 軸位置為 a 時，表示 X 軸數值，也就是資料值，

cues.en: being less than or equal to the value of x at point a.
cues.zh: 小於或等於 a 點所對應的 x 值的機率。

cues.en: You can also define this in terms of integrals, but in the context of this course, because we are focusing a lot on understanding statistics and probability theory using code
cues.zh: 也可以用積分定義，但這門課著重透過程式理解統計和機率理論，

cues.en: and applications in statistics, and in machine learning, and so on, I think this is a good formula to focus on.
cues.zh: 以及統計、機器學習等應用，因此我認為專注在這個公式很好。

cues.en: So it's the sum of all of the values from the beginning of x up until value a.
cues.zh: 也就是從 x 的起點到 a 值，所有數值的總和。

cues.en: So the cumulative sum, up to the current location on the x-axis, which here I'm indicating as a.
cues.zh: 累積加總到目前的 X 軸位置，這裡用 a 表示。

cues.en: Okay, so I hope that gives you some intuition and some definitions.
cues.zh: 希望這給了你一些直覺和定義。

cues.en: Now, I wanna walk through a couple of examples, and we'll do two examples in particular.
cues.zh: 現在看幾個例子，具體來說會做兩個。

cues.en: Okay, so cdfs are used to evaluate the probability of obtaining a value up until x or at least x.
cues.zh: CDF 可用來評估取得不超過 x，或至少為 x 的數值之機率。

cues.en: So up until some value of X.
cues.zh: 也就是直到某個 X 值。

cues.en: It's really just a restatement of what I said in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 其實只是重述上一張投影片的內容。

cues.en: Okay, so here's our first example that we're gonna go through.
cues.zh: 第一個例子如下。

cues.en: What is the probability of getting at least one standard deviation higher on the SATs than average?
cues.zh: SAT 成績比平均至少高一個標準差的機率是多少？

cues.en: So if you're not familiar with the SATs, these are standardized exams in the US that high school students have to take.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉 SAT，這是美國高中生必須參加的標準化考試。

cues.en: It's part of the requirements for getting accepted into a university.
cues.zh: 是大學錄取要求的一部分。

cues.en: So what is the probability of scoring at least one standard deviation higher on the SATs than the average SAT score?
cues.zh: SAT 成績比平均 SAT 成績至少高一個標準差，機率是多少？

cues.en: And then here's our second example, we're gonna go through both of these in a moment.
cues.zh: 第二個例子如下，等一下兩個都會處理。

cues.en: The second example is: What is the probability of an elephant weighing less than two standard deviations below the average?
cues.zh: 一頭大象的體重低於平均值兩個標準差以下，機率是多少？

cues.en: And this would be the average weight for an elephant.
cues.zh: 這裡指大象的平均體重。

cues.en: So poor elephant, it's...
cues.zh: 可憐的大象，它……

cues.en: This elephant is really, really skinny.
cues.zh: 這隻大象真的非常瘦。

cues.en: Maybe this elephant is really stressed out because he has to learn statistics and doesn't have any good resources.
cues.zh: 也許因為必須學統計，卻沒有好的資源，壓力很大。

cues.en: He's really stressed, they're not eating enough.
cues.zh: 壓力大得吃不下。

cues.en: So, okay, so what is the probability of an elephant weighing less than two standard deviations below the average?
cues.zh: 所以，大象體重比平均低兩個標準差以下，機率是多少？

cues.en: Okay, so here we have a cumulative distribution function, a cdf in blue, and in this case, this is the cdf of a Gaussian.
cues.zh: 這裡藍色是累積分布函數，也就是 CDF，這次是高斯分布的 CDF。

cues.en: So this is the cdf that corresponds to a Gaussian distribution or a normal standard distribution of bell curve distribution.
cues.zh: 對應高斯分布，也就是標準常態分布、鐘形曲線分布。

cues.en: And the reason why I chose this particular cdf, I mean this is just an example.
cues.zh: 我選擇這個特定 CDF 的原因，這當然只是例子，

cues.en: But now the SAT scores are...
cues.zh: 不過 SAT 成績……

cues.en: They are well known to be bell-curve-shaped.
cues.zh: 大家知道它呈鐘形曲線。

cues.en: They are Gaussian-distributed.
cues.zh: 呈高斯分布。

cues.en: And I have to admit, I don't actually know what the distribution of elephant weights is, but for the purpose of this example, we are going to imagine
cues.zh: 必須承認，我其實不知道大象體重的分布，但為了這個例子，先假設

cues.en: that elephant weights are Gaussian-distributed.
cues.zh: 大象體重呈高斯分布。

cues.en: Okay, so how do we answer this question?
cues.zh: 好，如何回答這個問題？

cues.en: How do we solve for the probability of getting at least one standard deviation above the average on the SAT?
cues.zh: 如何求出 SAT 成績比平均至少高一個標準差的機率？

cues.en: So to answer this question, what you do is you look at the x-axis here.
cues.zh: 先看這裡的 X 軸。

cues.en: We have our standard deviation units.
cues.zh: 這裡使用標準差單位。

cues.en: These are standard deviation units because that's like the definition of the Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 以標準差為單位，因為這算是高斯分布的定義。

cues.en: So we take our...
cues.zh: 所以取我們的……

cues.en: We look for 1, that's the question, one standard deviation.
cues.zh: 找出 1，因為問題是一個標準差。

cues.en: So we look at the x-axis coordinate for 1, and you go up vertically, you draw a line until you intersect the cdf.
cues.zh: 找到 X 座標為 1 的位置，垂直往上畫線，直到和 CDF 相交。

cues.en: And when you intersect the cdf, then you draw a line to the left, and you see what is the value over here.
cues.zh: 相交後，再往左畫線，看看這裡的值是多少。

cues.en: And I don't actually know what this numerical value exactly is, let's just say it's 8.85, it looks like it's somewhere around .85.
cues.zh: 我不知道精確數值，先說是 8.85，看起來大約是 0.85。

cues.en: Okay, now you have to be really careful about the wording here, about the phrasing, because the answer to this question is not .85.
cues.zh: 這裡必須非常小心措辭，因為這題答案不是 0.85。

cues.en: That is the incorrect answer to this question.
cues.zh: 那是錯誤答案。

cues.en: The question is: getting at least one standard deviation higher than the SAT on the SATs than average.
cues.zh: 問題是，SAT 成績比平均至少高一個標準差。

cues.en: So the answer .85 would actually be the correct answer to one standard deviation lower.
cues.zh: 0.85 其實會是低於那個一標準差位置的答案。

cues.en: So 85% of people who take the SATs score lower than one standard deviation above the mean.
cues.zh: 也就是 85% 參加 SAT 的人，成績低於平均值加一個標準差。

cues.en: So all of this stuff, this probability, math, all of this here, this is .85 or 85%.
cues.zh: 所以這一整塊機率、機率質量，這裡全部是 0.85，或 85%。

cues.en: Instead, the correct answer is all of this stuff up here.
cues.zh: 正確答案反而是這裡上方這一整塊。

cues.en: So what is the probability of getting higher than one standard deviation above the mean?
cues.zh: 比平均值高一個標準差以上的機率是多少？

cues.en: And the answer to that question is 1 minus .85.
So 15% or whatever this value happens to be.
cues.zh: 也就是 15%，或實際數值所對應的百分比。

cues.en: So let's say it's around 15%.
cues.zh: 先說大約 15%。

cues.en: That is the answer to this question.
cues.zh: 這才是這題的答案。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's do this second example.
cues.zh: 接著看第二個例子。

cues.en: What's the probability of an elephant weighing less than two standard deviations below the average?
cues.zh: 大象體重比平均低兩個標準差以下的機率是多少？

cues.en: Now, we start answering this question in exactly the same way.
cues.zh: 以完全相同的方式開始。

cues.en: So we look up on the x-axis, the location corresponding to the key term here.
cues.zh: 在 X 軸上，找出對應這裡關鍵詞的位置。

cues.en: So two standard deviations below the average over here.
cues.zh: 也就是這邊，比平均低兩個標準差。

cues.en: And again, we draw a vertical line up until we intersect with the cdf, and then we draw horizontal line to the left and we see what this value is.
cues.zh: 同樣地，畫垂直線直到和 CDF 相交，再往左畫水平線，看看這個值。

cues.en: Again, I probably could have looked this up before the lecture, but anyways, let's say it's like .03, it's somewhere around .03.
cues.zh: 我大概應該課前先查好，不過先說是 0.03，大約在 0.03 附近。

cues.en: Now, here, pay it...
cues.zh: 這裡要注意……

cues.en: We have to pay careful attention to the wording of this question as well.
cues.zh: 同樣必須仔細留意問題的措辭。

cues.en: The probability of an elephant weighing less than two standard deviations.
cues.zh: 大象體重低於兩個標準差的機率。

cues.en: So now in fact, we do want the density, the distribution to the left of minus 2.
cues.zh: 所以這次確實要取 −2 左側的密度、分布。

cues.en: So now, the correct answer actually is .03.
cues.zh: 正確答案就是 0.03。

cues.en: If we would rephrase this question and say, "What is the probability of an elephant weighing more than two standard deviations below the average?"
cues.zh: 如果把問題改成：「大象體重大於平均值減去兩個標準差的機率是多少？」

cues.en: Then the answer is all of this stuff to the right, which is .97.
cues.zh: 答案就會是右側全部，也就是 0.97。

cues.en: So the answer to this question is everything to the left, that's .03.
cues.zh: 因此，這題答案是左側全部，也就是 0.03。

cues.en: The last thing I want to point out here with these two questions, these two examples, is the question here is not: What is the probability of getting exactly
cues.zh: 關於這兩題、這兩個例子，最後還想指出，問題不是：恰好得到

cues.en: one standard deviation higher than the average?
cues.zh: 比平均高一個標準差的機率是多少？

cues.en: So that's not the question here.
cues.zh: 這裡不是問這個。

cues.en: The question is the probability of getting at least one standard deviation higher.
cues.zh: 而是問，至少比平均高一個標準差的機率。

cues.en: So at least and less than, these are the key phrases here.
cues.zh: 「至少」和「小於」是這裡的關鍵詞。

cues.en: So this means that we take all of these numbers together, and all of this stuff together is 1 minus .85.
cues.zh: 所以要把所有這些數字一起考慮，全部合起來就是 1−0.85。

cues.en: Okay, so in this video, I introduced you to cumulative distribution functions.
cues.zh: 好，這部影片介紹了累積分布函數。

cues.en: Again, they're fairly straightforward, they're just the sum, the cumulative sum of the probability function.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，相當直接，就是機率函數的總和、累積總和。

cues.en: In the next video, you will see cdfs implemented in MATLAB and in Python.
cues.zh: 下一部影片會看到 MATLAB 和 Python 的 CDF 實作。
